Top U.S. voter concern

The Economy

Jobs, prices and the cost of living.

  • ✓Supports a large expansion of federal child care funding
“Massively expand federal investment in child care.”
Source: Platform and Policies - Lasher for Congress (campaign site)

What this means for youFamilies paying for child care could see lower costs if federal funding grows. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.
